item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json; from work import evaluate\\n\\ndef chk(req, ev, pol, expected):\\n before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,ev,pol)==before\\nbase={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2},'extra':9}}\\nchk({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','b']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b','z']})\\nchk(base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}},'verified':False},{'source':'w','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\nchk(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}},'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})\\nchk(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})\\nchk(base,[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})\\nchk(base,[{'source':'x','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':2}}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['x'],'unknowns':[]})\\nprint('edge checks passed')\"]}"}
